hero.title: Two Platforms. One Industrial Ecosystem.
hero.intro: DYNATECH operates through a dual business model combining exclusive international industrial partnerships with a fully integrated automotive and technical infrastructure platform in Egypt.
hero.supporting: Together, these two platforms create a bridge between global technology providers and regional industrial growth opportunities.

partnerships.title: Bringing European Industrial Expertise To The Region
paragraphs: DYNATECH serves as the exclusive regional gateway for two of Europe’s leading industrial technology organizations: FFT Produktionssysteme GmbH and Composites United.

Through these partnerships, companies and institutions across the Middle East can access advanced manufacturing systems, lightweight material technologies, automation solutions, and industrial development expertise directly through DYNATECH.
partnerships.whyText: As industries across the region accelerate toward electrification and advanced manufacturing, access to proven global technologies becomes increasingly critical. DYNATECH helps simplify that access by connecting regional opportunities with trusted industrial expertise from Europe.

partners.name: FFT Company
partners.heading: We are production optimizers
paragraphs: Since 1974, FFT has stood for dynamism, solidity, global presence and a claim to technological leadership.
As a leading global provider of innovative, flexible and complex manufacturing systems, FFT specializes in their development, project planning and implementation.
FFT assumes overall responsibility for turnkey solutions and carries out projects worldwide, including for the automotive and aviation industries.

partners.name: CU Company
partners.heading: About Composites United
paragraphs: Composites United e. V. (CU), one of the world's largest networks for fiber-based multi-material lightweight design, emerged from the two associations Carbon Composites e. V. and CFK Valley e. V.
About 350 members have joined to form this high-performance industry and research association to jointly develop lightweight design solutions for the future.

hub.title: A Fully Integrated Automotive & Technical Destination
paragraphs: The DYNATECH Automotive Hub is designed as a next-generation automotive ecosystem supporting both traditional and electric mobility operations.

Rather than functioning as a traditional service center, the hub combines technical operations, EV infrastructure, training, workshops, administration, logistics, and showroom capabilities into one integrated environment.

egypt.title: Why Egypt?
paragraphs: The country is rapidly positioning itself as one of the region’s most important automotive and industrial investment destinations.
With growing government investment, infrastructure expansion, and future mobility initiatives, Egypt is creating significant opportunities for industrial localization and technology transfer.
DYNATECH was built to help connect these opportunities with the global expertise needed to support them.

hero.title: Our Exclusive Technology Partners
paragraphs: DYNATECH holds exclusive representation agreements with two of Europe’s most respected organizations in advanced manufacturing systems and lightweight material technologies.
These partnerships position DYNATECH as a direct bridge between global industrial expertise and Egypt’s future mobility and manufacturing ecosystem.

partners.name: Composites United (CU)
partners.title: Composites United (CU)
paragraphs: One of the world’s largest networks specializing in fiber-based multi-material lightweight construction, connecting manufacturers, research institutes, universities, and advanced technology organizations across Europe and globally.
With a network of approximately 350 member organizations, Composites United plays a major role in shaping the future of lightweight manufacturing and advanced material technologies.
partners.roleText: DYNATECH serves as the exclusive representative of Composites United in Egypt, supporting the transfer and localization of lightweight material technologies into customer-oriented industrial solutions within the Egyptian market.
partners.milestoneText: Strategic agreement officially announced during Hannover Messe 2022.

partners.name: FFT Produktionssysteme
partners.title: FFT Produktionssysteme
paragraphs: Founded in 1974, FFT is one of the world’s leading providers of intelligent and flexible manufacturing systems, delivering complex turnkey production projects across five continents for more than 50 years.
FFT operates across automotive, aviation, and industrial manufacturing sectors, supporting globally recognized clients including BMW, Volkswagen Group, and Xiaomi Auto.
partners.roleText: DYNATECH serves as FFT’s exclusive agency partner in Egypt, supporting the introduction of advanced manufacturing systems, industrial solutions, and future mobility infrastructure into the local market.
partners.milestoneText: Exclusive agency agreement signed at FFT Headquarters in Fulda, Germany — November 2023.

ecosystem.title: Two Partnerships. One Industrial Ecosystem.
paragraphs: Through its partnerships with FFT and Composites United, DYNATECH connects advanced manufacturing systems with next generation lightweight material technologies.
Together, these agreements bring more than 100 years of combined European industrial expertise directly into Egypt’s future automotive and industrial landscape.
